objective: Certificar Gate 9 de persistencia fisica de Cavas Corporativas en SQL canonico. Verificar existencia de las 8 tablas core, PK/FK internas, indices de idempotencia/operacion y conteos actuales. No escribir SQL, no modificar datos y no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_core_tables
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name IN ('CavasCorporativas_OrganizacionesRef','CavasCorporativas_Convenios','CavasCorporativas_ConvenioUnidades','CavasCorporativas_Autorizados','CavasCorporativas_Beneficios','CavasCorporativas_BeneficioAlcances','CavasCorporativas_Politicas','CavasCorporativas_AplicacionesBeneficio') ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_primary_keys
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, i.name AS pk_name FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.is_primary_key=1 WHERE t.name LIKE 'CavasCorporativas[_]%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table, fk.name AS fk_name, OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE 'CavasCorporativas[_]%' ORDER BY parent_table,fk.name

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_required_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_unique FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.index_id>0 WHERE t.name LIKE 'CavasCorporativas[_]%' AND i.name IN ('UQ_CC_Aplicacion_Idempotencia','UX_CC_Alcance','IX_CC_Convenios_OrganizacionEstado','IX_CC_Autorizados_Identidad','IX_CC_Aplicaciones_Operacion') ORDER BY t.name,i.name

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, SUM(p.rows) AS row_count FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name LIKE 'CavasCorporativas[_]%' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

constraints: Expected foreign keys only within CavasCorporativas domain
Expected idempotency unique constraint/index for AplicacionesBeneficio
